title: 第616章 死马当活马医第615章 有些后悔的潘威
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“我倒是有三个条件。”
林晨双眸微微一挑，当下他确实有一件很急切的事情。
他在古洞府获得的天灵傀，之前在天云山为了抵挡那个黑袍强者，被对方重创，身躯出现很多道裂痕，若是无法及时修复，恐怕那具天灵傀就只能毁了。
以他目前的修为，能够有一具真武境的天灵傀留在手中，确实对他来说也是不小的助力。
“噗！”
潘威后面不远处站着的冯德坤，听到林晨居然还想要提条件，瞪大双眼，差点没有笑喷出声来。
“哦？林小兄弟有什么条件，你尽管提，潘城主应该都会答应你。”潘威还没来得及说话，旁边的袁畅率先开口。
他也有些好奇，林晨会提什么条件。
“我想要去巨峭城城主府找一些矿石材料，顺便还需要五十枚中品灵晶，借用城主府的灵脉用用。”林晨倒也不客气，直接说道。
天灵傀出现裂痕，就需要不少的矿石材料，以及中品灵晶。必须要在灵力充沛之地，一边修复一边蕴养，才能够修复。
“我还以为是什么条件，只要小兄弟能够替城主府获得比武大会第一，我都可以满足你。”
听到林晨提出来的条件，潘威倒是松了一口气。
毕竟在他眼中，林晨提出来的条件很简单，城主府库房里面，堆积着很多矿石材料，大部分都是用来打造兵器，也没什么太大的用处。
唯独五十枚中品灵晶有些珍贵，却也在他的承受范围内。至于借用城主府的灵脉，他隐约猜到林晨的目的，对方修为是元婴境三重巅峰，肯定是想要借助灵脉突破修为。
“潘城主可能理解有些错误。”听到潘威的话语，林晨神色淡然：“这些条件，需要潘城主先兑现承诺，我再去代表城主府参加比武大会。”
“小……子……”
看着林晨的神情，完全是蹬鼻子上脸，冯德坤性格本就有些火爆，当即就有些忍不住，就准备发怒。
“没问题。”看着袁畅对林晨的态度，潘威觉得反正林晨提出来的条件也不苛刻，就当是卖给袁畅一个人情，直接爽快答应了。
至于林晨能够代表城主府获得比武大会第一，他也不指望了。
“那就有劳了。”

林晨也不客气，直接说道。
“潘城主，那我就不打搅你们了。”袁畅脸上浮现出笑容，对着潘威微微抱拳，笑道：“我在这里，提前祝贺潘城主明日比武大会胜利。”
说完对着林晨微微颔首，朝着房间方向走去。
“任奕，就由你带林小兄弟去库房，挑选完矿石后，从城主府的财务账上，支取五十枚中品灵晶。然后去城主府的高级修炼室，里面可以动用城主府的灵脉。”随着袁畅离去，潘威转过身看向任奕吩咐道。
“遵命！”
任奕虽然内心很不情愿，却也看得出来，袁畅肯定是有心磨炼身前的青年，若是拒绝的话，就等于拂逆对方的面子，到时候恐怕大家都会闹得很不愉快。
“林公子，这边请！”
content_en:
"I do have three conditions."
Lin Chen raised his eyes slightly, he did have something urgent to do at the moment.
The Heavenly Spirit Puppet he obtained in the Ancient Cave Mansion was severely injured by the black-robed strongman in Tianyun Mountain when he resisted it. There were many cracks in the body. If it could not be repaired in time, I am afraid that the Heavenly Spirit Puppet would have to be destroyed.
With his current cultivation level, having a True Martial Realm Heavenly Spirit Puppet in his hands would indeed be a big help to him.
"Poof!"
Feng Dekun, who was standing not far behind Pan Wei, widened his eyes when he heard that Lin Chen actually wanted to raise conditions, and almost burst out laughing.
"Oh? Little brother Lin, if you ask for any conditions, City Lord Pan will probably agree to it." Before Pan Wei had time to speak, Yuan Chang next to him spoke first.
He was also a little curious about what conditions Lin Chen would put forward.
"I want to go to the City Lord's Mansion in Giant Cliff City to find some ore materials. I also need fifty medium-grade spiritual crystals to borrow the spiritual veins from the City Lord's Mansion." Lin Chen said directly without being polite.
If there are cracks in the Tianling Puppet, a lot of ore materials and medium-grade spiritual crystals will be needed. It must be repaired in a place with abundant spiritual power, repairing and nourishing at the same time.
"I thought it was a condition. As long as the little brother can win the first place in the martial arts competition for the city lord's palace, I can satisfy you."
Pan Wei was relieved when he heard the conditions proposed by Lin Chen.
After all, in his eyes, the conditions proposed by Lin Chen were very simple. There were a lot of ore materials piled up in the warehouse of the City Lord's Mansion, most of which were used to make weapons and were of little use.
Only fifty middle-grade spiritual crystals were somewhat precious, but they were within his affordability. As for borrowing the spiritual veins from the City Lord's Mansion, he vaguely guessed Lin Chen's purpose. The opponent's cultivation level was at the peak of the third level of Nascent Soul Realm, so he definitely wanted to use the spiritual veins to break through.
"City Lord Pan may have some misunderstandings." Hearing Pan Wei's words, Lin Chen looked calm: "These conditions require City Lord Pan to fulfill his promise first, and then I will go to represent the City Lord's Mansion in the martial arts competition."
"Little...zi..."
Seeing Lin Chen's expression, which was completely irritating, Feng Dekun had a fiery personality, so he couldn't help it and was about to get angry.
"No problem." Looking at Yuan Chang's attitude towards Lin Chen, Pan Wei felt that the conditions proposed by Lin Chen were not harsh anyway, so he treated it as a favor to Yuan Chang and readily agreed.
As for Lin Chen being able to represent the City Lord's Mansion and win the first place in the martial arts competition, he had no hope.
"Then it'll be hard work."
Lin Chen was not polite and said directly.
"City Lord Pan, then I won't disturb you anymore." A smile appeared on Yuan Chang's face, he cupped his fist slightly towards Pan Wei and said with a smile: "I am here to congratulate City Lord Pan in advance for his victory in tomorrow's martial arts competition."
After saying that, he nodded slightly to Lin Chen and walked towards the room.
"Ren Yi, you will take Brother Lin to the warehouse. After selecting the ore, withdraw fifty medium-grade spiritual crystals from the financial account of the City Lord's Mansion. Then go to the advanced training room of the City Lord's Mansion, where you can use the spiritual veins of the City Lord's Mansion." As Yuan Chang left, Pan Wei turned to look at Ren Yi and ordered.
"As you command!"
Although Ren Yi was very reluctant in his heart, he could also see that Yuan Chang must have the intention to train the young man in front of him. If he refused, it would be tantamount to betraying the other person's face, and everyone would be very unhappy by then.
"Master Lin, please come this way!"
